eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Junior Sales Account Manager (B2B) is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: SoftTrend leverages extensive experience in IT to understand and address diverse customer needs and requirements. The Junior Sales Account Manager will also coordinate with internal teams to align solutions with client requirements and contribute to sales reporting and forecasting. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service skills, with a focus on building trust and long-term relationships. Candidates should possess Lead Generation expertise, including researching potential clients, initiating contact, and qualifying opportunities in B2B markets. Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or a related field are beneficial. Basic proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) is helpful.
